description: This file contains the implementation of a Logo class with initialization, collision detection, movement, and drawing methods. It also includes setup and draw functions to initialize the environment and animate multiple Logo instances.

classes.name: Logo
classes.description: A class representing a moving logo object with position, velocity, and collision handling.

methods.name: Logo:init
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize a Logo instance with position and velocity.

methods.name: Logo:collision
methods.description: Detects and handles collision with window borders, reversing velocity accordingly.

methods.name: Logo:move
methods.description: Updates the position of the logo based on velocity and handles collision.

methods.name: Logo:draw
methods.description: Renders the logo image at its current position.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the environment, loads resources, initializes logos, and configures frame rate.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws background and updates all logos by drawing and moving them.
